name: Doro Wat
description: Slow-simmered tender chicken leg and hard-boiled egg infused with rich berbere spice blend, clarified niter kibbeh butter, and sweet caramelized onions.

name: Shiro
description: Velvety spiced chickpea and broad bean stew cooked in a traditional clay pot (mankorina) with garlic, minced shallots, and ginger.

name: Kitfo
description: Prime lean beef finely minced and seasoned with warm mitmita chili powder and fragrant niter kibbeh herb butter, served with ayib cheese and gomen.

name: Tibs
description: Sautéed tender beef cubes seared over high heat with rosemary sprigs, sweet red onions, and hot jalapeño peppers.

name: Injera Firfir
description: Shredded teff injera gently soaked in spicy berbere stew, infused with cardamom, garlic, and seasoned clarified butter.

name: Beyaynetu
description: A vibrant rainbow platter of vegetarian stews: misir wat, ater kik, collard gomen, fosolia green beans, and seasoned beetroot salad on 100% teff injera.

name: Misir Wat
description: Split red lentils simmered patiently in rich berbere sauce, garlic, and fresh ground ginger until deeply savory and comforting.

name: Gomen
description: Tender chopped collard greens steamed with aromatic garlic, sliced ginger, and cold-pressed Ethiopian vegetable oil.

name: Atkilt Wot
description: A mild, naturally sweet blend of cabbage florets, tender carrots, and potato chunks braised in golden turmeric oil.

name: Derek Tibs
description: Crisp-fried beef cubes seasoned with crushed black pepper, fresh rosemary, and awaze dipping sauce.
